summary: This clinical trial studies weight loss treatments using the drug liraglutide by itself or combined with the drug orlistat in adults who are overweight or have obesity. The study is sponsored by The Fourth Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine and plans to enroll 120 participants. Currently, the trial has a status of Not yet recruiting and is classified as Phase 4.

facts.sponsor: The Fourth Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine
